scope: Representative post-0.26 escaped defects with reviewable regression evidence; this is not an issue-count census.

property_catalog.law: No command may create, change, or remove files outside its declared write set.
A command that fails before commit preserves all durable project and user state.
Cleanup changes only APM-owned state and preserves user and surviving-package ownership.
Repeating a converged operation leaves durable bytes unchanged.
Only explicitly effective targets receive package primitives and service configuration.
Materialized content, resolved references, and cache identity describe the same source revision.
Equivalent inputs produce portable paths and deterministic bytes across supported platforms.
Exit status and diagnostics truthfully describe the durable outcome.
Successful fresh HTTP cache reads protect entries from eviction without extending response TTL or causing a refetch.
Credentials remain scoped to their intended host and never enter persisted URLs or output.

bugs.summary: Repeated install rewrote unchanged ownership and lockfile timestamps.
Target contraction reintroduced a removed deployment path.
Cold-cache CI audit produced false failures and false-green results.
Package target restrictions leaked hooks into sibling harnesses.
Audit omitted deployed files that no lockfile entry claimed.
MCP-only install omitted the lockfile and could not audit cleanly.
A changed aliased ref reused stale cached content.
Global uninstall left managed Copilot hook files behind.
Manifest rewrites caused repeated Windows line-ending churn.
Legacy cached plugin upgrade deleted valid prior deployments.
Git-hook installs could mutate the invoking repository and expose transport state.
Unknown host-qualified package paths reached mutable install work.
Uninstall reported success and discarded ownership after package deletion failed.
Cache pruning evicted checkouts just reused by a frozen install.
Successful MCP HTTP cache hits did not refresh LRU recency and were evicted before cold entries.
Regression-only coverage: shared transitive instructions survive either diamond parent's uninstall and are removed after the last parent.
Cache clean reported success despite failed Git db, checkout, or HTTP removal.
Cache prune counted failed removals as successful and exited zero.
Prune reported success after orphan deletion failed, including partially completed batches.
Negative cache-prune ages deleted fresh installed Git checkouts.
Lexical HOME/APM_HOME aliases must deploy the same authorized bytes as canonical roots.
Fresh resolution rejected manifestless nested skill collections accepted by package validation.

lifecycle_contracts.assessment: Bounded #2867 contract adapted from a42fe808128d5866c17d93fe63ed4b57d0426ea0 and d2f90486e748b21091403c288e2db6457b4ce7c6, not an execution receipt. Real canonical/aliased HOME/APM_HOME and project trajectories observe CLI subprocesses, immutable fixture revisions and user-owned bytes. State observed permits cache effects; scenario assertions independently enforce expected bytes, identities and write bounds. Project-only find refusal and targets observations do not claim global lookup support. The ninth project witness extends the historical eight with real semver transport refusal/recovery from 60a9a5ca85829d0f83989f5aa5fc5b04cb0ae815.

commands.reason: Root dispatch/help has no standalone dependency transition.

approve.reason: The passive package has no executable primitive grant to approve; scenario-local hook sentinels are preauthorized controls.

audit.reason: Checks damaged, repaired and removed installed state, using physical APM_HOME globally.

cache.reason: Dispatch only; cache leaves are assessed individually.

cache clean.reason: Removes disposable cache without removing installed B; source rehydration proves recovery.

cache info.reason: Reads cache bookkeeping without changing installed dependency bytes.

cache prune.reason: Fresh entries survive supported no-op pruning.

compile.reason: Instruction outputs at A and B must track installed revision changes.

config.reason: Shows CLI preferences; fixed fixture path/target inputs are not preference resources.

config get.reason: Reads preference keys, not installed dependency ownership.

config list.reason: Lists preferences, not deployed package revisions.

config set.reason: Mutates preference resources outside the fixed-environment lifecycle.

config unset.reason: Removes preference overrides absent from this fixture.

deny.reason: Passive package executable grants are absent; hook sentinels are fixed controls, not grant lifecycle subjects.

deps.reason: Dependency dispatch only; leaves are individually assessed.

deps clean.reason: Removes modules but retains deployment/lock, then audit fails and install repairs.

deps info.reason: Reads installed metadata from physical APM_HOME without an invented global flag.

deps list.reason: Reads supported user-scope installed dependency inventory.

deps tree.reason: Reads user-scope dependency graph without changing deployment.

deps update.reason: Exercises the legacy update registration on real installed revisions.

deps why.reason: Reads dependency provenance from the user lock.

discover.reason: Inventories existing native/local packages and optionally adopts their references into a consumer manifest; these fixtures install explicitly declared Git dependencies, not undeclared native-package adoption.

doctor.reason: Diagnoses host tools/network/auth rather than installed passive dependency state.

experimental.reason: Established Claude/Hermes targets require no feature-toggle resource.

experimental disable.reason: No experimental feature is enabled to remove.

experimental enable.reason: Enabling a separate experimental capability is not passive-package materialization.

experimental list.reason: Lists feature flags, not package ownership.

experimental reset.reason: Resets feature preferences the fixture does not own.

find.reason: Project-relative lookup refuses absolute global records with unchanged state and exit 1; not successful global lookup.

info.reason: Hidden installed-metadata alias is actually invoked with supported global scope.

init.reason: Scaffolds a manifest or discovers/adopts existing native packages; this lifecycle starts from an explicit Git dependency declaration and does not perform native-package adoption.

install.reason: Materialization, replay, refusal, repair and reinstall advance one durable trajectory.

lifecycle.reason: Lifecycle-script dispatch is not a dependency materialization command; script sentinels are fixed test controls.

lifecycle init.reason: Authors lifecycle scripts, not installed skills/instructions.

lifecycle test.reason: Synthetic script event execution differs from the real install hooks observed here.

lifecycle trust.reason: Changes script trust; sentinels are preauthorized controls, not changing trust resources.

lifecycle untrust.reason: Revokes script trust, outside fixed sentinel authorization.

lifecycle validate.reason: Validates authored script files, not installed primitive revision identity.

list.reason: Lists project run scripts; none are declared by this passive package.

lock.reason: Resolves lock state while preserving deployed files and ownership.

lock export.reason: Exports real A/B commit identities as CycloneDX and SPDX.

marketplace.reason: Marketplace dispatch; no marketplace catalog participates in direct Git dependencies.

marketplace add.reason: Adds a discovery catalog source, not a direct dependency.

marketplace audit.reason: Audits against marketplace sources absent from this fixture.

marketplace browse.reason: Browses catalog entries; no catalog is declared.

marketplace check.reason: Checks marketplace entries absent from the manifest.

marketplace init.reason: Authors a catalog rather than a direct Git package.

marketplace list.reason: Lists configured catalogs, not installed direct dependencies.

marketplace migrate.reason: Migrates a legacy catalog; no such resource is present.

marketplace outdated.reason: Checks catalog freshness, not the covered installed dependency freshness.

marketplace package.reason: Catalog-package editing dispatch; no catalog is authored.

marketplace package add.reason: Adds producer catalog entries, not consumer dependencies.

marketplace package remove.reason: Removes producer catalog entries; consumer removal uses uninstall/prune.

marketplace package set.reason: Edits catalog metadata, absent for direct Git references.

marketplace remove.reason: Removes discovery catalogs, not installed direct dependencies.

marketplace update.reason: Refreshes catalog state, distinct from dependency revision update.

marketplace validate.reason: Validates catalog authoring documents absent here.

mcp.reason: Service dispatch; package declares no MCP service.

mcp install.reason: Configures executable MCP servers absent here.

mcp list.reason: Lists MCP services, not passive skills.

mcp search.reason: Searches MCP registries, not the explicit Git source.

mcp show.reason: Reads MCP registry records absent from the fixture.

outdated.reason: Observes upstream B while deployment remains A; cache effects are allowed.

pack.reason: Produces an archive; this lifecycle consumes Git rather than a bundle.

plugin.reason: Plugin authoring dispatch; the fixture is an existing passive package.

plugin init.reason: Scaffolds a producer rather than transitioning an installed dependency.

policy.reason: Policy dispatch; no changing policy document participates.

policy explain.reason: Explains executable trust, not passive deployment ownership.

policy status.reason: Inspects policy posture; no policy source changes here.

preview.reason: Previews run-script prompts; no project run script is declared.

prune.reason: Project declaration removal; global removal uses uninstall instead.

publish.reason: Publishes registry artifacts; fixture revisions are local Git commits.

run.reason: Executes project run scripts, absent from this passive package.

runtime.reason: AI-runtime dispatch; runtime binaries are not package primitives.

runtime list.reason: Lists AI runtime binaries, not dependency revisions.

runtime remove.reason: Removes runtime binaries; dependency removal is separately covered.

runtime setup.reason: Installs AI runtime binaries outside this passive package lifecycle.

runtime status.reason: Checks runtime availability rather than installed package state.

search.reason: Searches marketplace catalogs absent from the direct Git fixture.

self-update.reason: Replaces APM itself; this verifier holds its source interpreter and launcher fixed.

targets.reason: Observes empty caller project markers, not global deployment inventory.

uninstall.reason: Removes globally owned bytes, permits clean audit and fresh reinstall.

unpack.reason: Extracts bundles; none are declared in the Git fixture.

update.reason: Advances installed bytes, resolved commit and ownership to B.

view.reason: Reads installed package metadata, not remote registry discovery.

project.preparation: Replace the owned project skill with tampered user bytes.
Remove the dependency declaration from this manifest.
Tamper with the skill and remove its declaration; preserve user bytes.
Restore the declaration, retaining collision bytes.

model-global-update.preparation: Publish B outside observed roots while installed A remains intact.
Declare a missing ref to require frozen refusal.
Restore ref then explicitly select GitLab for the same custom host.

required-global-update.preparation: Publish B outside observed roots while installed A remains intact.
Declare A while lock records B.
Declare full commit A and install its original bytes.
Keep manifest ref and locked resolved_ref at A; corrupt only locked resolved_commit to real B.
Restore exact matching A lock bytes; replay must preserve pinned deployment.
Restore original main declaration and install B.

required-audit-matrix.preparation: Restore exact B bytes after deletion.
Restore exact B bytes after modification.
Move source modules outside state root.
Replace ledger ownership with unknown owner.
Restore skill bytes after symlink control.
Delete Claude skill and modify Hermes skill together.

global-reinstall.preparation: Restore removed declaration in the same user manifest; model variants publish C and seed only a sibling virtual-package lock entry, requiring current upstream rather than cached B.

semver.preparation: Declare real tagged semver range with initial transport.
Flip transport while retaining semver range.
Declare inverse initial transport with same real tagged semver range.
Flip inverse transport while retaining semver range.

known_gaps.summary: A recursive deletion failure can leave earlier packages or some files removed; declarations and lock ownership remain available for retry.
known_gaps.next_decision: Filesystem rollback is not guaranteed; retry uninstall after resolving the error or reinstall declared packages.

known_gaps.summary: An injected lockfile replacement failure can occur after target files move to the newly declared target while the prior lockfile remains intact.
known_gaps.next_decision: Full install transaction expansion remains deferred with phases 2-4.
